source.method: Static Android APK protocol enums and UI mappings; app not executed.
source.hardware_support: Catalog definitions are not firmware capability confirmation.
source.unresolved_labels: Null names preserve intentionally/unresolved unnamed UI parameter types; use internal_type/parameter_id.
source.ui_units: Use integer UI units. wire value = ui value * wire_multiplier. Physical units unspecified unless separately verified.

wire.parameter_edit: Preserve slot, algorithm, config and bypass; send exactly one requested parameter.
wire.model_edit: Target algorithm/config; omit bypass with255; value_count0; change based on CURRENT model UI type (Amp/Cab3; Classic2).
wire.bypass_edit: App copies current slot, algorithm/config and value list; substitutes only bypass with requested Boolean. No dedicated empty-value-list bypass callsite verified.
wire.notification_omission: FF bypass decodes null and copyWith preserves the preceding bypass; not proof of its current value.
